segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 1-2
segments.he: קהל וחזן: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר:
segments.en: The Congregation says and the Chazzan repeats: We will hallow Your Name in the world, as they hallow it in the heavens above, as is written by the hand of Your prophet, And they called one to another, and said:

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 3-4
segments.he: קהל וחזן: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ:
segments.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: ‘Holy, holy, holy, is Adonoy of Hosts, the fullness of all the earth is His glory.’”

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 5-6
segments.en: The Chazzan says: Those facing them say “Boruch...”

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 7-8
segments.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from its place

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 10-9
segments.en: The Chazzan says: And in Your Holy Words it is written:

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 11-12
segments.he: קהל וחזן: יִמְלֹךְ יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:
segments.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: Adonoy will reign forever; Your God, Zion, throughout all generations! Praise God.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Keduasha 14
segments.he: לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ: בעשי"ת מסיים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ:
segments.en: From generation to generation we will declare Your greatness, and to all eternity, we will sanctify Your holiness, and Your praise, our God, will not depart from our mouth forever and ever; because You are the Almighty Who is King; Great, and Holy. Blessed are You, Adonoy, the Almighty, the Holy One.
